title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཞ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 100)
shelf_note: Canonical Tibetan Buddhist treatise from the Madhyamaka section of the Derge Tengyur (vol. 100, ཞ).

tr_errors_B.english: the first root verse ... this third root verse ... The fourth root verse ... the second root verse
tr_errors_B.problem: Mistranslates the four lines/pādas of the root kārikā as separate 'root verses'

tr_errors_B.english: if it is established / established agent / established action
tr_errors_B.problem: Mistranslates 'sadbhūta' (existent entity / real) as 'established' (siddha), confusing ontological existence with logical establishment

tr_errors_B.english: proves the reason and the example / used to prove the reason and the example
tr_errors_B.problem: Misinterprets setting up the root verse lines as the statements of reason and example (hetu/dṛṣṭānta-vākya) as 'proving' the reason and example

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A is philosophically precise and accurately identifies the four lines (pādas) of the root kārikā, whereas Translation B repeatedly mistakes each line for a separate root verse and conflates existence (sadbhūta) with establishment (siddha).

book_verdict: A clean woodblock print folio from the Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka section with flawless OCR; Translation A accurately renders the logical commentary and technical vocabulary.
